featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely pathetic gym experience. The gym is always overcrowded with no proper management or trainers available to guide members. Washrooms are dirty, equipment maintenance is extremely poor, and half of the machines are constantly out of service.

The staff at the reception, especially Mr. Adnan, is very rude and completely unfriendly towards customers. Before taking the membership, they make a lot of promises, but once the payment is done, none of those promises are fulfilled.

The crowd is so bad that you literally have to wait 15–20 minutes just to use a machine. Overall, a very disappointing experience and definitely not worth the membership fee. I would not recommend this gym at all.

featured_reviews.name: Yadnesh Potdar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointed with the way this gym has handled its renovation closure.
The gym has been shut for over 3 months for relocation purposes, yet there has been little to no communication from management regarding proper reopening timelines, membership extensions, pauses, or refund options. Every update seems to be delayed, and im given new dates about when new facility will actually open. Upon visiting the Tardeo branch for inquiry i am being told to check if the branch is open after few days as if the only job i have is to keep checking when will they open myself.
Super unprofessional and unpleasant behaviour from the staff and lack of transparency. Would not recommend, even local gyms have better customer support than this.

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text: When I say you're better off being literally at any other gym over this one, believe me. It's run by a bunch of goons who have no way of speaking to their clients, unless it's about pestering you to renew your membership. At admission they'll promise a whole bunch of services, all to no avail when you've actually paid up. Dirty washrooms, unmaintained equipment and purely money oriented trainers. Do yourself a favour and avoid this one. Literally a week after collecting payment they shut down their Tardeo branch without any prior intimation inspire of being well aware of the situation. Can get far better gyms at the premium rate they try to exploit people with.

People are really keen to take your membership they will call you 10 times and make sure you buy membership but once you join no one is there to take a note on your problems or to guide... Also If we talk about guidance i am not asking for any trainer to make you train but atleast keep one attendee on each floor who is APPROACHABLE for any small things like speaker not working or ac not working etc, people who work there are not polite, not genuine, it always feels they are just not interested in anything.
Overall space is good
Gym equipments are really good (if they maintain properly)
Crowd is also good

I hope they view the comment and improve 🙏.

I was benching alone and while I was doing my very light warmup weight, a trainer came up behind me and reached to spot me without asking. I was NOWHERE close to failing, nor was I in danger. Spotting someone on bench press means, to put it crudely, hanging your crotch over their face, and potentially touching their chest/breast if you do need to help. I am simply stunned that anyone would think it’s appropriate to come so close to me without seeking consent. Mere minutes later, another trainer approached me when I was in the middle of a rep on a machine to try to talk to me. Later, when the bill was presented, we noticed the item listed as egg omelette sandwich. We immediately clarified that there must be a mistake, as we had not ordered or ever consumed eggs. The waiter admitted that he had misunderstood the order but took no responsibility for the error. When we spoke to the caterer about it, the response was dismissive and insensitive.

To make matters worse, the waiter made an inappropriate comment, joking that “the chicken was Jain,” which was extremely disrespectful and offensive to our faith.

We believe this incident deserves serious attention. Serving non-vegetarian food to a Jain family after a clear vegetarian order, followed by mockery from the staff, is unacceptable. We request you to kindly look into this matter, take appropriate action, and ensure that such incidents do not happen again.

We have always valued Hindu Gymkhana and hope that the management will uphold the respect and trust of its members and guests.

Thank you for your understanding and prompt attention to this matter.

featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are looking for a fitness center that balances a professional environment with a welcoming community feel, I will surely recommend Flex Iron Gym (Vikhroli West).

Standout points are:
1. Expert and Friendly Staff: One of the highlights of this gym is the staff. Trainer Sukanya, in particular has a very friendly nature and approachable attitude. Having a trainer who is supportive makes a huge difference, especially on days when your motivation is low.

2. Well-Equipped Facilities: The gym is stocked with high-quality, well-maintained machines. Whether you are focused on heavy strength training or functional movements, you’ll find the right tools for your workout.

3. Fair Cardio Policy: To ensure every member gets a fair chance to work on their heart health, the gym has a 15-minute limit on cardio machines during peak times. This helps every member to get a fair chance to do their cardio.

4. Gym Vibe: The gym maintains a high standard of hygiene and has a high-energy vibe that keeps you focused on your goals.

featured_reviews.name: Anj Illustrator
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this gym recently after a long break, and the experience was disappointing. There was no receptionist, and the system was not working. Instead of handling this professionally, the coach Sukanya assumed I did not have a valid membership and asked for a screenshot of my payment. Even after I showed the bill, she said that my admission was taken by another trainer (Ashwini) and that she needed to “cross-check,” which felt like poor internal coordination and unnecessary doubt placed on the member.

As someone returning after a break, I expected at least basic guidance or a welcoming attitude, but the behavior was rude and unprofessional.

I was doing cardio on the treadmill, and although no one was waiting to use it, I was asked to step down immediately after 15 minutes, without any flexibility and in a very rude manner.

Overall, the environment feels uncomfortable, and the trainers seem focused mainly on personal training. Members who don’t opt for PT are not treated well. Due to similar behavior, my sister shifted from this women’s gym to a unisex gym, where professionalism and member treatment are much better.

I was planning to extend my membership, but after this experience, I won’t be doing so. I hope the management improves staff coordination, professionalism, and customer handling.

I had severe sciatica pain to the extent that I couldn’t walk. With her guidance, awareness-based training, and consistent work, the pain has now reduced to once in a while. I also struggled with knee pain, which improved significantly through her rehab-focused exercises. Even one focused session with her made a noticeable difference.

Today, I can run better, and something very special to me—I’m able to teach cycling to my daughter, which once felt impossible. Along with healing, I’ve also seen a physical transformation, moving from size XXL to Large.

Shivani doesn’t just train the body; she understands pain, movement, and mindset deeply. I’m extremely grateful for her support, patience, and commitment to long-term well-being. Highly recommend her to anyone looking for sustainable, pain-free movement and true healing.

I’d definitely recommend him to anyone looking for long-term fat loss through proper nutrition rather than quick fixes.
